# solo-msa_v2-gemini-3-flash-flash_10-low

<!-- Generated by tools/export_results.py. Edit only the Experiment and Observations sections. -->

## Experiment

One agent implements both features with `gemini-3-flash-preview` at `low` thinking, the lowest level both models support (`gemini-3.8-flash` rejects `minimal`). Budgets are the upstream defaults (100 steps, compaction at 28K). Comparing it with `gemini-3.8-flash` at `low` shows the difference between the models at the same thinking level.

## Observations

- 5/10, compared with 6/10 for `gemini-3.8-flash` at `low` and 7/10 for this model at `minimal`. All three are within run-to-run variation of each other.
- This model still finished faster than `gemini-3.8-flash` at the same level: 47 steps per pair on average versus 80, 1 agent at the step limit versus 4, and 1.0 compactions per agent versus 1.7.
- The model produced no reasoning tokens at `low` either (same as at `minimal`), so for this model the two levels may behave alike.
- 26 calls were retried because of the API rate limit, which only slows `solo` agents down.
